title: Incident room
idea: Incident room: Current severity and assigned actions precede incident chronology
audience: People who need to coordinate incident within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: The UI would imply emergency service guarantees
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its coordinate incident priority and explicit commitment contract: Acknowledgement assignment and resolution are separate states
navigation: Incident room keeps the current coordinate incident context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Current severity and assigned actions precede incident chronology
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to coordinate incident; teams need shared incident context
composition.priority: Acknowledgement assignment and resolution are separate states

imagery.role: Support the actual coordinate incident context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize latest confirmed event and next owner
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the incident room structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no coordinate incident content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Acknowledgement assignment and resolution are separate states
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized coordinate incident content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Acknowledgement assignment and resolution are separate states
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active coordinate incident context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
